zebraPlainsCollection.unit: per person, Adult Sharing basis unless noted

Zebra River Camp.config: 15 River-Facing Tents (Talek River), 1 Family Tent, min 4 pax for family tent
Zebra River Camp.gamePackageAdds: Shared game drives; 4-7 pax in one car gets exclusive vehicle use at no extra charge
Zebra River Camp.fullBoardAdds: Laundry (excl. underwear), selected in-house alcoholic/non-alcoholic drinks

Zebra Valley Camp.config: 18 Savannah Facing Tents, 1 Family Tent, min 4 pax for family tent
Zebra Valley Camp.rates: Identical rate structure to Zebra River Camp (same figures)

Little Zebra River West & East Camps.fullBoardAdds: Laundry, selected alcoholic/non-alcoholic drinks (some premium included), 45-min Swedish massage per guest once/stay
Little Zebra River West & East Camps.gamePackageAdds: Exclusive 4x4 vehicle, sundowner, walking safari, Maasai cultural visit

Royal Zebra River Safari Lodge.config: 5 Luxury Savannah View Suites, 3 Luxury Forest Suites
Royal Zebra River Safari Lodge.fullBoardAdds: Laundry, drinks (some premium incl.), sundowner, private butler, bubbly breakfast, 45-min Swedish massage once/stay
Royal Zebra River Safari Lodge.gamePackageAdds: Exclusive 4x4, airstrip transfers, bush breakfast/lunch/dinner, walking safari, Maasai cultural visit

Praro Amboseli Camp.config: 46 tents, 1 Savannah Facing Family Suite (2BR villa+lounge), 1 Junior Family Tent (1 double + 2 twin beds, ideal for under-12s)

conservancyFee.note: Only charged to Full Board guests who choose to do game drives in Aloca Conservancy - waived entirely for Game Package guests in 2027

childPolicy.oneAdultOneChild: 75% of single room rate + child sharing rate
childPolicy.twoAdultsPlusChildren: Adult sharing rate + child sharing rate each

zebraPlainsCollection.mandatoryFeesNote: Park/Conservation fees NOT included in any rate above; valid 12 hours in Maasai Mara, 24 hours in Amboseli; subject to change without notice

festiveSupplement.dates: New Year 31/1, Christmas 24/25, Easter Fri/Mon, Valentine's

zebraPlainsCollection.tourLeaderFamPolicy: Tour leader pays 50% of contracted rates (low season, full board only). FAM trip agents pay 50% of contracted full board rates (low season only) unless otherwise agreed.
zebraPlainsCollection.cancellationPolicy: 60 days before arrival: 65% credit note; 45 days: 45% credit note; 30 days: 25% credit note; under 30 days: no credit note

seasons.mid: 3 Jan-31 Mar, 1-30 Jun, 1-31 Oct, 1 Nov-18 Dec

Lalashe Maasai Mara.inclusions: Luxury tent accommodation, all meals/snacks, alcoholic/non-alcoholic drinks in camp and safari, exclusive custom open-sided vehicle, unlimited game drives, guide, airstrip transfer, walking safari, Rhino Sanctuary visit, Maasai cultural visit, 45-min Swedish massage, Amref emergency medical cover, bush breakfast/lunch/dinner, bush sundowner, WiFi, laundry, all taxes

Lalashe Mara Ripoi.inclusions: Same as Lalashe Maasai Mara plus Maasai village visit and elaborate walking safari; also includes conservancy fees (Lalashe Maasai Mara's list does not explicitly mention conservancy fees as included - flagged as a difference between the two otherwise-identical rate sheets)
